institutes.equipmentNotes: No institute-published supply list was found. Program pages confirm workshop-based practice in product design (industrial creation, jewelry), space design (interior architecture, scenography), image design (graphic advertising) and ceramics; a 2012 article mentions jewelry/craft students in workshops. GENERIC (not ISAMMH) references only: a general ceramics guide (ceramiste.net/le-materiel-de-poterie-indispensable/) lists estèque, ébauchoirs en bois, rouleau + tasseaux, planche de bois non vernie, aiguille, éponge, couteau; a French DNMADE design supply list (lycée Loritz 2026-2027 PDF) cites a laptop (>=1920x1080, >=512 GB SSD) and Photoshop, Illustrator, Rhino, AutoCAD, SketchUp. Confirm with ISAMMH departments before publishing.
institutes.notes: Under Université de Monastir; created 2005 (fr.wikipedia). Address: Avenue/Rue Taher Haddad, 5100 Mahdia; institutional phone +216 73 697 382 (search snippet of isammh.rnu.tn). Official site isammh.rnu.tn posts 'Nouveautés' (avis, emplois du temps, exam calendars, results) - cached items seen date from 2022-2023 so posting frequency is unclear; Facebook page 'ISAM Mahdia' (self-described 'Page officiel', ~10k likes, links isammh.rnu.tn) likely carries day-to-day announcements; an older second page also exists (~9.4k likes). Masters 2026-2027: applications 10/11-25 July 2026 via isammh.rnu.tn (orientini). Master application is online via the institute site; research master selection = file + written/practical test (2023-24 page). Design céramique: orientini (23-07-2024) says the co-built licence was open to ISAMMH students who completed L2 Design Produit (création industrielle or bijoux); a um.rnu.tn notice snippet describes it as for Design Produit graduates (licence or master), one year = one semester of teaching + one semester end-of-studies internship. Treat duration/entry level as unconfirmed. universite.tn directory only lists 'LA en Design Produit (Création artisanale / Bijoux)' (outdated). No Moodle, Instagram, public student group or old-exam archive found. Note: 'ISAMM' is also used by Institut Supérieur des Arts Multimédia de la Manouba (facebook.com/Isamm.Tunisia) - do not confuse. isammh.rnu.tn and um.rnu.tn could not be fetched directly from the research environment; content comes from search-engine snippets.

calendars.summary: National calendar (Ministry of Higher Education circular as relayed by orientini.com): classes start 1 Sept 2026 for preparatory institutes, engineering schools, faculties of medicine/dental medicine/pharmacy and ISETs; 12 Sept 2026 for all other institutions. Min. 28 teaching weeks. Winter break 12-27 Dec 2026; spring break 19 Mar-4 Apr 2027. Holidays: 15 Oct 2026, 17 Dec 2026, 1 Jan 2027, 20 Mar 2027, 9 Apr 2027, 1 May 2027 + religious holidays (dates TBD). Exam periods not stated.
